text: Good evening, I am very sorry to be troubling you at this hour, maf korben. I am the grandfather, my nati Rupa is 9 years old and staying with us this week while her parents are away. Since yesterday she is saying her ear is hurting, the left one, kaner byatha she says, and she keeps pulling and rubbing at it. Tonight she came to our room saying it hurts more and she cant sleep properly. I think it is the ear only, she is not complaning of anything else. She also has some insect bites on her arms and one on her ankle, mosha kamor I beleive, from sitting in the garden, they are itchy and she is scrachting them. My wife was worried about the bites so we did the glass test like they say on the television, pressed a glass on them and they all go pale, white under the glass, so I think that is ok? There is no other rash anywhere, we checked her back and legs also. Ki korbo bujhte parchi na, should we wait till morning and take her to the doctor or is there something to do now for the ear? I dont want to give wrong medicine, her mother usualy handles all this. Again sorry for bothering, ami khub chinta korchi, I am just an old man who worries too much probably. Thank you.
